scope: Deep-dossier qualification of Marconi Technologies, its concrete tactical-radio, troposcatter, SATCOM and sensor-fusion technologies, Canadian ownership and manufacturing context, and current allied contract activity.

prospects.name: Marconi Technologies
prospects.fitSummary: The official site establishes a Montréal defence-technology company with a broad, concrete communications and mission-systems portfolio.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Official portfolio and contact material resolved identity, Canadian headquarters, products, public contacts and international footprint.

prospects.name: Marconi Orion X650 Polish military contract
prospects.fitSummary: Government reporting independently confirms a current made-in-Canada tactical-radio contract and Canadian supplier base.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The Prime Minister's Office corroborated the supplier, product, customer, value threshold, delivery horizon and Canadian production claim.

prospects.name: Marconi Archer Swedish FMV trials
prospects.fitSummary: A current field evaluation provides concrete operating evidence for the Archer troposcatter product beyond its marketing datasheet.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The attributed release resolved the FMV evaluation setting, 75-kilometre link, deployment mode and network-node integration.
